screens.title: 开始任务
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: PrintFlow Studio / SCRUM-11168 / home-screen high-fidelity raster prototype.
Reference image role: the attached existing review-screen prototype is a DESIGN SYSTEM reference only. Create a NEW different screen in precisely the same visual system, not a collage or picture of that screen.
Primary request: ONE complete, front-on, edge-to-edge Windows desktop app screenshot, wide landscape 16:10. A calm premium modern professional creative tool for an inexperienced print-shop operator. Accurate, crisp Simplified Chinese, meticulous alignment, generous efficient spacing, CJK sans serif, matte off-white canvas, white surfaces, graphite text, forest-teal primary, thin dividers, 10-12px corners, very restrained shadows. The reference titlebar and "PrintFlow Studio" wordmark remain consistent, small "视觉原型 v1" label, neutral window controls. No browser, no physical device, no perspective, no outer presentation frame.
Screen: clean task-focused home. A slim left navigation rail labeled simply with "开始任务" selected, "最近任务", "环境检查"; bottom links "设置" and "帮助". Main content starts with a small overline "开始任务", large heading "从一张图片开始", subtitle "导入图片，PrintFlow 会一步一步引导你完成。". Main central import area is a large beautifully restrained dashed-outline drop zone, small elegant file/image outline icon, exact headline "将图片拖到这里", short "一次处理一张图片", ONE solid teal main button "选择图片". Make this hero surface central and inviting with negative space, no giant decorative abstract artwork, no chart or promotional content.
Below or beside the main drop zone, a low-emphasis neutral environment summary strip with a hollow circle icon, exact title "环境尚未检查", short text "开始自动处理前，需要检查工作站。", outlined secondary action "检查环境". Do not show false green-ready status or pretend anything has been checked.
Lower main section is "继续处理", two compact cards each showing the same synthetic botanical orange fox artwork from the reference as a small thumbnail. Card one "山野狐狸.png", small amber badge "待审核", secondary "继续审核". Card two "徽章设计.png", neutral label "有保存记录", secondary "查看记录". These are understated recent-job entries, not a dashboard. Footer hint "原图保留在本地。".
Constraints: show only home-relevant information. No route buttons before file import, no print-size fields, no TIFF form, no reviews or approvals on Home, no live production controls, no account/avatar, no business metrics, no orders, no batch features, no cloud promises. Do not add an enabled AI-generation action because that integration is conditional and unavailable in this core prototype. Output ONLY this polished practical UI screenshot.
screens.intent: 突出单张图片导入；环境未检查时明确告知；继续任务为次级入口。
screens.hidden: 路线参数、图片审核、印刷尺寸、保存表单。

screens.title: 审核图片
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: High-fidelity raster visual prototype for SCRUM-11168, PrintFlow Studio Windows desktop app, Simplified Chinese, design candidate v1.
Primary request: Create ONE exceptionally polished, practical modern desktop application screen for a step-by-step print-production assistant. This is a flat, front-on, edge-to-edge UI screenshot, wide landscape about 16:10. The entire image is the actual app window. No device, no browser, no desk, no perspective, no surrounding presentation board. It should look like a beautifully designed shippable professional creative desktop product, calm, humane, readable, meticulously aligned, with excellent typography and restrained visual density.
Design language: matte near-white #F6F7F4 canvas, white working surfaces, deep graphite #202E2A text, restrained forest-teal #16765D main accent, pale mint selected states, thin neutral dividers, 10-12px corner radii, discreet shadow only where needed. CJK sans-serif like Microsoft YaHei / Noto Sans SC. Generous but efficient spacing. Avoid purple gradients, glass, neon, enormous pills, excessive nested cards, marketing graphics or decorative charts.
Layout: narrow top titlebar with a simple original geometric page mark plus exact wordmark "PrintFlow Studio" at left, quiet window controls at right. Below it a slim header showing task "山野狐狸.png", route "处理客户设计", and small "本地任务" indicator. Left 210px navigation column with exact heading "处理步骤" and vertical numbered progression: "导入与路线" completed, "确认原图" completed, "图片增强" completed, "去除背景" ACTIVE with small badge "待审核", "裁切画布" upcoming, "印刷设置" upcoming, "生成与审核" upcoming, "保存结果" upcoming. Completed stages have small checkmarks, active stage highlighted in pale mint, future stages muted and visibly not clickable. Bottom of left rail has subdued "返回主页" and "帮助".
Current task in main content: large exact heading "检查去背景结果"; short sentence "请确认主体完整，边缘没有残留。"; small step overline "当前步骤 · 去除背景". Main workspace has a very large image comparison region, with two equal previews side by side, exact labels "处理前" on LEFT and "处理后" on RIGHT. Both previews contain the exact same synthetic print-ready decorative illustration: a bold vivid burnt-orange red fox surrounded by sage foliage and small cream wildflowers, outlined ink details, isolated emblem composition, high visual quality. Before preview has a neutral cream rectangular source background; after preview shows subtle light transparency checkerboard around the identical fox and foliage. The art is large, attractive, centered and unclipped. This synthetic image is sample print artwork, not customer data. A compact toolbar above the previews has "并排对比", zoom minus and plus, "100%", and "适合窗口". No general drawing or eraser tools.
To the right of comparison, a narrow unobtrusive contextual guidance column, exact title "检查要点" with three concise lines "主体是否完整" / "边缘是否干净" / "透明区域是否正确"; use small neutral outlined circles, not fake prechecked quality assurances. Underneath a lightweight hint "不确定时，可请同事修正。" The preview receives most of the screen's area.
Fixed footer across main content, separated by a hairline: quiet left action "查看上一步"; small informative sentence "通过后进入裁切，当前结果尚未保存。"; on right a subtle text action "请同事修正", an outlined secondary "驳回此结果", and ONE solid forest-teal primary button "通过此结果" with modest right arrow. Buttons around 42px high. Approve does NOT imply save. Critical distinction: the displayed step is BACKGROUND REMOVAL REVIEW, not completion and not final output.
Constraints: render all quoted Simplified Chinese text accurately and sharply, no random extra copy, no nonsensical metrics, no charts, no order management, no avatars, no account features, no AI automatic approvals, no print/printer buttons, no filename paths or hashes in primary UI, no print dimensions form or export form on this review step, no fake completion percentage. Preserve safe visual separation between navigation, viewing, and approving. Use plenty of breathing room while remaining realistic for a 1000x700-or-larger desktop window. A small unobtrusive top label "视觉原型 v1" may distinguish the concept. Output only this one complete UI screenshot.
screens.intent: 去背景审核示例：处理前在左，处理后在右；大图、检查要点和当前决策聚焦。
screens.hidden: 尺寸输入与导出表单；通过不表示保存。

principles: 真实状态优先于装饰反馈

reviewNotes: 图片是合成素材，文件名、输出路径、尺寸与状态是视觉示例，不是生产执行记录。
侧栏为用户阶段投影，不新增业务StepKind；处理和待审子状态仍分别受原工作流约束。
本轮未提交Git、未改产品源码，也未将Epic或子项标记Done。
路线选择图中顶部路线名代表当前草稿选择，不代表业务处理已开始。
审核图的圆形检查提示采用生成器的表现；实施时应使用非交互要点图标，除非另有清单设计。
图片示例外观仅用于布局评审，不能作为TIFF通道、CMYK或输出尺寸验证。
